description: UTILITIESCOMMUNICATION_stormwater_control_drain_area is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. Storm water control drainage areas were delineated using site plans, elevation contours, aerial photos, and drainage infrastructure GIS. These areas are used in land area and impervious cover level of treatment analysis. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category Environment. Its tags are stormwater control, stormwater control drain area, watershed protection, watershed, agoltosocrata. The table has 17 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2026-09-07 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
